_meta.source: Booking confirmations (Oct 28) + V2 plan + Claude suggestions
_meta.notes: V3 route: Tokyo (Ueno) 7 nights, Nagoya 3, Hiroshima 3, Osaka 5 (Kobe as a day trip), Kawaguchiko 1, Tokyo (Asakusa) 7. Opening hours, closed days and light-show dates in this file were checked on 2026-10-28 against the sources listed in verification_sources. Items with source claude are suggestions. verified=false means the organizer has not confirmed the 2026 dates yet.
_meta.fx_note: Estimate used by the page: JPY 1,000 = USD 6.33. Change here to update every USD amount.
_meta.dining_note: dining items belong to one day (day) and are grouped by type: sushi, ramen, sweets, coffee, other. kind: r = named place, s = local specialty, q = map search. They are never part of the route links.
_meta.nearby_note: itinerary days carry 'nearby': bonus ideas near that day's area, hidden in the page by default. All entries are Claude suggestions (source claude) from general knowledge, not live lookups: verify opening days and hours before going. kind r = named place (directions), q = map search.
_meta.shopping_note: Shopping lives on each itinerary day (day.shopping).
_meta.checklist_note: checklist entries: book = needs a booking or confirmation; verify = check hours or dates; decide = choose between options; gap = not in the plan yet; assume = an assumption the plan depends on. Delete an entry when it is done.

trip_checklist.text: Hiroshima hotel for Dec 27 to 30: not booked yet (V1 Kuretakeso booking was Dec 28 to Jan 2; no new confirmation).

Shinkansen seats: Tokyo to Nagoya (Dec 24), Nagoya to Hiroshima (Dec 27), Hiroshima to Shin-Osaka (Dec 30), Osaka to Shin-Fuji for Kawaguchiko (Jan 4), Kawaguchiko to Tokyo (Jan 5). Peak days; reservations usually open about a month ahead.
Klook Hida Takayama and Shirakawa-go day trip on Sat Dec 26: not booked.
Disney dated ticket for Thu Jan 7 (Disneyland or DisneySea).
New Year's Eve plan in Osaka (see the Osaka checklist).
JR Pass or single tickets. Compare once the seat reservations are set.
Hotel for the night of Dec 15 in Los Angeles (Volaris lands 22:24; United leaves 11:30 the next day).
Airport transfers: Haneda to Ueno on Dec 17 (landing 16:30) and Asakusa to Haneda on Jan 12 (ANA leaves 21:05).
Luggage: five hotel moves with four bags (Dec 24, Dec 27, Dec 30, Jan 4, Jan 5). Plan forwarding (takkyubin) or lockers.
Travel insurance and connectivity (eSIM or pocket Wi-Fi for four weeks). Cash: carry yen.
Holiday meals: Christmas Eve (Nagoya), Christmas Day (Nagoya), New Year's Eve (Osaka) and New Year's Day. Restaurants fill fast and many close.
Year-end closures from Dec 28 to Jan 3: Hiroshima, Osaka, Kobe and Nagoya shops and sights can close early. Check every opening day.
US entry at LAX: confirm ESTA or visa status, transit rules, and that Karla's segments and seats match Reynaldo's. Passports valid for the whole trip.
Hotels in the email confirmations (Nagoya, Osaka, Kawaguchiko, Asakusa) are booked. Prices are not in those emails, so they are left blank.
Trains are the default transport. Wanderlog times are driving estimates. Prices use the fixed rate in the data.

leg_label: Tokyo (Ueno base): lights and Christmas markets

lodging.name: APA Hotel Ueno Eki Minami
lodging.notes: Confirmation carried over from the V2 plan.

transport.out: Shinkansen Tokyo to Nagoya on Dec 24 (about 1 h 40 min on Nozomi; reserve seats). Leave Ueno late morning to reach the KOKO Hotel in Nagoya before the evening
transport.local: JR Yamanote / Metro with IC card (Suica/Pasmo)

places.name: Yoshiike Main Store
places.notes: Arrival evening, close to the hotel. Seafood and food floors close at 20:30, so go only if you reach Ueno by about 19:30; the 8th and 9th floor restaurants stay open to 23:00. If you arrive later, Ichiran Ueno or Ameyoko snacks are the fallback.

places.name: Ueno Zoo
places.notes: Open Fri Dec 18. Closed every Monday and Dec 29 to Jan 1. Go first thing: the pandas draw queues later in the day.

places.name: National Museum of Nature and Science
places.notes: Open Fri Dec 18 (closed Mondays and Dec 28 to Jan 1). Allow 2 to 3 hours. Permanent exhibits need no reservation.

places.name: Ameyoko market
places.notes: Best at dusk after the museum. Shops close about 20:00; year-end crowds build toward Dec 28 to 31. No official Christmas illumination was found for Ueno Park or Ameyoko in 2026.

places.name: Tsukiji Outer Fish Market
places.notes: Open Sat Dec 19. The market is closed Wednesdays, Sundays and national holidays. Most lively 9:00 to 13:00; many stalls close by early afternoon.

places.name: Marunouchi
places.notes: Nakadori Avenue illumination. Marunouchi Illumination Nov 12, 2026 to Feb 14, 2027; the Christmas edition (Bright Holiday) runs Nov 12 to Dec 25. Go after dark.
places.hours: Lit about 16:00-23:00 (organizer had not published final hours)

places.name: Ikkaku
places.notes: Could not match "Ikkaku" to a known Ginza restaurant from the name alone (search returned nothing reliable). Confirm which restaurant this is in your Wanderlog list and its closed day before relying on it.

places.name: Uniqlo Ginza Flagship Store
places.notes: Bring passport for tax-free

places.name: Ginza Six Rooftop Garden
places.notes: Free rooftop garden; go before dusk, then walk to dinner.

places.name: Akihabara Gachapon Hall
places.notes: Bring lots of 100-500 yen coins
places.hours: Verify on the day (not found in a reliable source)

places.name: mAAch ecute Kanda Manseibashi
places.notes: Under old railway arches; nice at night

places.name: Tokyo Dome City
places.notes: Winter illumination runs Nov 19, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Open Sun Dec 20. Go after dark, after the Akihabara shops.

places.name: Enoshima
places.notes: Shonan no Hoseki (one of Japan's three great illuminations) Dec 1, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Sea Candle observation deck is open Mon Dec 21. Samuel Cocking Garden is free until 17:00, then 500 yen. Sunset is about 16:30.

places.name: Kamakura
places.notes: Keep it short: Komachi-dori snacks and shopping only, no temples. Then the Enoden train to Enoshima (about 25 min).

places.name: Takeshita Street
places.notes: Very crowded on weekends/holidays

places.name: Omotesando Hills
places.notes: Omotesando illuminations Dec 1 to Dec 25, 2026 (dates tentative), sunset to 22:00. Walk Omotesando at dusk on the way to Shibuya.

places.name: Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza B
places.notes: Christmas Market (Central Plaza) and street lights Nov 21 to Dec 25, 2026. teamLab Borderless is optional and needs a dated ticket. Kamiyacho Station is next door, and Tokyo Tower is about 20 minutes on foot.

places.name: Roppongi Keyakizaka Dori
places.notes: Illumination Nov 5 to Dec 25, 2026. Dec 23 is within the run. Go after 17:00.

places.name: Roppongi Hills
places.notes: Christmas Market (Oyane Plaza) Nov 21 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:00; West Walk tree Nov 13 to Dec 25.

places.name: Tokyo Tower
places.notes: Book ahead. Go at golden hour (sunset about 16:30) so the view works in daylight and at night.
places.hours: Main Deck 9:00-23:00 (last 22:30); Top Deck Tour to 22:45 (last 22:15)

places.name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
places.notes: Dec 11 to 27, 2026 per japan-guide (Oct 18 update); the organizer has not confirmed. Replaces daytime Yoyogi Park.

places.name: Tokyo Midtown Christmas lights
places.notes: Lights Nov 26 to Dec 25. The bubble show ends Dec 20, so on Dec 23 you see the lights without bubbles. Path of Light and the ice rink (Dec 5 to Feb 23, 11:00-21:00) continue.

doesnt_fit.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building
doesnt_fit.notes: Free observatory. Fits only if a Shinjuku evening is added (for example Dec 22 instead of Shibuya). Closure days were not verified; check the official page. Shinjuku Southern Terrace lights nearby run Nov 11 to Feb 14, 16:30-24:00.

doesnt_fit.name: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse Christmas Market
doesnt_fit.notes: Runs to Dec 25 per a travel guide (dates not re-checked in this pass). Swap for Kamakura on Dec 21 if you want one more market.

doesnt_fit.name: Tokyo National Museum
doesnt_fit.notes: Honkan rooms 17-20 closed to Dec 31, rooms 2-3 closed from Dec 14, and the Toyokan is closed Nov 30 to Dec 31. From Dec 22 to 25 only the Horyuji Gallery and Kuroda Hall are open, and the museum is closed Dec 26 to 31. Dropped from Dec 18 so the zoo day stays manageable.

doesnt_fit.name: Odaiba
doesnt_fit.notes: Decks Odaiba lights run year-round 17:00-24:00, and Tokyo Christmas Market Shin-Toyosu runs Nov 20 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:30 (1,000 yen weekdays, 1,500 weekends, 2,000 yen Dec 24-25). It is an evening on its own. Cleanest swap: do Odaiba instead of Tokyo Dome City on Dec 20 (the Dome lights run to Feb 28 and can move to a day in the Asakusa stay).

doesnt_fit.name: AQUA CITY Odaiba
doesnt_fit.notes: Goes with the Odaiba evening above; not scheduled.

doesnt_fit.name: Kanda Myoujin Shrine
doesnt_fit.notes: Shrine; skippable and not a priority for you.

doesnt_fit.name: Hibiya Park
doesnt_fit.notes: No Hibiya Christmas market is listed for 2026 (the Tokyo Christmas Market venues are Shin-Toyosu and Shiba Park). Optional 10-minute walk between Ginza and Marunouchi.

doesnt_fit.name: Yoyogi Park
doesnt_fit.notes: Low value in winter; replaced by the Shibuya Blue Cave evening.

winter_lights.name: Marunouchi Illumination (Nakadori / Tokyo Station)
winter_lights.window: Nov 12, 2026 to Feb 14, 2027 (Christmas edition to Dec 25)
winter_lights.notes: Nakadori Avenue. Also on when you return in January.

winter_lights.name: Tokyo Dome City Winter Illumination
winter_lights.notes: Free to walk through the main lights.

winter_lights.name: Shonan no Hoseki (Enoshima Sea Candle)
winter_lights.notes: Sea Candle deck 9:00-21:00 (800 yen). Garden free until 17:00, then 500 yen. Sunset about 16:30.

winter_lights.name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
winter_lights.window: Dec 11 to 27, 2026 (listed by japan-guide; not yet confirmed by the organizer)
winter_lights.notes: Check the official Blue Cave site in early December. If it is cancelled, use the Omotesando lights and Yebisu instead.

winter_lights.name: Omotesando illuminations
winter_lights.notes: Fits the Omotesando stop at dusk.

winter_lights.name: Yebisu Garden Place (Baccarat chandelier)
winter_lights.window: Lights Nov 14, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027; chandelier to Jan 11, 2027
winter_lights.notes: One stop from Shibuya. Optional add-on; the Christmas tree and markets end Dec 25. Also an option when you are back in January (chandelier to Jan 11).

winter_lights.name: Azabudai Hills Christmas Market and lights
winter_lights.notes: Central Plaza market, Sakuraasa-dori lights and the Garden Plaza B tree.

winter_lights.name: Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Illumination
winter_lights.notes: Dec 23 is within the run. Roppongi Hills Christmas Market (Oyane Plaza) Nov 21 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:00.

winter_lights.name: Tokyo Midtown Christmas lights
winter_lights.window: Nov 26 to Dec 25, 2026 (bubble show ends Dec 20)
winter_lights.notes: Lights only on Dec 23 (no bubbles). Path of Light and the ice rink continue to Feb 23, 2027.

winter_lights.name: Tokyo Christmas Market, Shiba Park
winter_lights.notes: Next to Tokyo Tower. Paid entry: 1,000 yen on weekdays through Dec 23. Optional.

itinerary.title: Ueno Zoo, Nature and Science Museum, Ameyoko
itinerary.notes: Zoo first (9:30), museum after lunch, Ameyoko at dusk: a straight line from the park to the market with no backtracking. Tokyo National Museum moved to Doesn't fit (partial closures in December). No official Ueno Christmas lights found for 2026.
itinerary.claude_suggestion: Zoo 9:30 to 12:30, lunch, museum 13:30 to 16:00, then Ameyoko as it gets dark.

itinerary.claude_suggestion: Leave Ueno by 9:30, Komachi-dori for lunch, Enoshima by 15:30, stay for the lights.

checklist.text: Markets and light shows that end Dec 25 (Roppongi, Azabudai, Midtown, Shin-Toyosu, Shiba Park) are all before your Dec 24 departure; Dec 23 is your last night for the Roppongi, Azabudai and Midtown lights.
Blue Cave (Dec 11 to 27) and Omotesando (Dec 1 to 25) are not confirmed by their organizers yet. Check japan-guide.com/e/e2303.html and the Blue Cave site in early December.
Tokyo Tower (Dec 23) and Ikkaku (Dec 19) are marked book ahead. Tokyo Dome City lights need no ticket.
Haneda to the Ueno hotel on Dec 17 (landing 16:30): no transfer planned.
Dec 24: Shinkansen Tokyo to Nagoya; check out of Ueno and store bags for the Nagoya check-in.
Identify "Ikkaku" (Dec 19). It did not match a known Ginza restaurant; confirm the name and closed day.
Akihabara shop hours (Gachapon Hall, Mandarake, Kotobukiya) on Sun Dec 20 were not found in a reliable source; check each shop site.

Dec 21 is long (about 3 hours of train): keep Kamakura Komachi-dori or go straight to Enoshima?
